office_policy: Map P39 QIDs only, never office labels or similar strings. Only exact_office rows can propose an office equivalence; family_only and external_only require separate historical research. No claim of actual power or continuity of legal jurisdiction.

mappings.note: Emperor of all the Russias is a legal imperial title. Does not assert practical dominance.
Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of USSR; do not conflate with Presidium chair.
Chairman of USSR Council of Ministers from 1946; not Council of People's Commissars or composite legacy-g06.
Wikidata item groups general secretary and first secretary; canon distinguishes titles, Stalin 1934 changes, and leadership interpretations.
King of Prussia is a foreign juridical office and has no v1 canonical office ID.
Elective Holy Roman emperor office; not sovereign nationality, territory, or Habsburg composite monarchy.
